_meta.note: Every frame is a live claude-agent-acp 0.107.0 (v1 core) frame over Claude Code 2.1.325, recorded by Crew's in-product recorder (KIROCREW_ACP_RECORD_FRAMES) on a dashboard turn whose Claude Code ran with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 and so offered the Task* tools instead of TodoWrite: the eight `plan` updates of that turn, in order, as the recorder wrote them (keys sorted), with only the session id replaced by a synthetic one. Three TaskCreate calls and one TaskUpdate to completed; each change arrives twice, from the TaskCreated / TaskCompleted hook (dist/v1/acp-agent.js:7607-7627, publishTaskPlan) and from the tool result (dist/sdk-to-acp.js Task* branch), because dist/tools.js changedTaskPlanEntries repeats a plan for every client but AIR; no tool_call row is sent for a Task* call (dist/sdk-to-acp.js shouldEmitToolCall). Held as synthesized, not live, because the corpus holds every live claude capture to the Real Adapter lane's pin (test/real_adapters/package.json, test_real_adapter_fixture_pins.py), which this release is not; a re-capture at the pin is what makes it live. The usage, message and prompt-result frames of the turn are left out: they carry the recording account's model ids and cost, and the turn's prompt and answer were not written for this corpus.
